newsitem.title: CAMBODIA: Senior Chinese official visits Cambodia amid row.
newsitem.headline: Senior Chinese official visits Cambodia amid row.

text.p: Luo Gan, secretary general of China's State Council, or cabinet, arrived in Cambodia on Friday for a four-day visit expected to touch on a recent row over Cambodia-Taiwan air links.
Luo Gan, who will meet Cambodian co-Premiers Prince Norodom Ranariddh and Hun Sen during his visit, was on a "goodwill visit," Chinese embassy officials said.

But they said Cambodia's recent decision to sign an aviation pact with Taiwan would likely be discussed along with Cambodia's political scene, which has been riven by tensions between the co-premiers.
"We will reiterate our stance to the Cambodian government," the embassy official said. "Any official agreement with Taiwan is not acceptable to China."
Taiwan's EVA Airways announced Taipei-Phnom Penh services in February, saying the two countries had signed a direct air link agreement in December.
Cambodia has no diplomatic ties with Taiwan but allows the island republic to maintain a trade office in Phnom Penh.
Beijing was one of the architects of the 1991 Cambodian peace accord and recognised the coalition government that emerged in U.N.-sponsored 1993 elections.
